weekend_note: Showers are likely today (Tue) and tonight, with only about a 30% chance Wednesday evening for the First City Lights kickoff downtown. The Nov 6 to 8 weekend looks pleasant, with highs in the 70s and lows in the 50s and low 60s, and a 20% chance of showers Saturday night and Sunday. That suits the mostly outdoor picks: the free Blue Angels Homecoming Air Show, Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival, Greek Festival and Frank Brown songwriter shows. Mozart & Bizet at the Saenger on Saturday night is the indoor pick. Hurricane Isaias recovery still affects some places, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: Escambia LOST sales tax renewal on the Nov 3 ballot
news.source: Pensacola News Journal via Yahoo News
news.summary: Voters decide on extending the one-cent sales tax to 2038. Supporters say it would raise at least $1 billion; if it failed and statewide Amendment 3 passed, the county projects about a $120 million yearly gap.

news.title: Pensacola Beach short-term rental rules up for possible vote Nov 4
news.summary: The Santa Rosa Island Authority board meets at 5 PM Wednesday. The draft requires annual registration, a 24/7 local contact and parking documentation, with repeat violations leading to staff meetings and possible enforcement.

news.title: FEMA individual assistance approved for Escambia and seven other counties
news.summary: Housing, repair and other storm aid was announced Oct 29, with applications through DisasterAssistance.gov.

news.title: Navy identifies three sailors killed in Oct 24 Pensacola crash
news.source: Pensacola News Journal via Yahoo News
news.summary: The Navy released the names of three airmen who died in a vehicle crash in Pensacola.

news.title: Escambia resident dies of Vibrio vulnificus infection

news.summary: The resident in their 70s is the sixth Florida death from the bacteria this year, with 34 statewide cases reported.

coverage_note: Updated Tuesday, Nov 3. This run confirmed the November events list on PensacolaBeach.com and the National Weather Service forecast (Nov 3 to 9 only; rain chances for Nov 5 and 6 were not stated, so those are carried over and the Nov 9 low is a rough estimate). Many other pages (WEAR, Must Do Pensacola, Visit Pensacola, NorthEscambia.com) would not open, so news and restaurant items are carried over from Nov 2 and not refreshed, and no new Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment events were added; coverage of north Escambia is thin. Events dropped were those that ended before today, and Monday Night Blues was removed because the next date was not confirmed. Later-November and December items are carried over and not reconfirmed.
